entries.value: "User persona store (SQLite store at ~/.base-studio-code/personas.db) for base-studio-code (#2094) — the agent-identity library (start prompt + skills + model, over a referenced role), a thin persona-specific shim over the shared bsc-json-store (#2158), reachable from the Tauri app's persona bridge and the session-facing `bsc persona` CLI."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# The core lib (no Tauri, no SQLite) so the tiny CLI reuses it without dragging the whole desktop app
# in. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_persona` crate name.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store + CLI scaffold (#2158) — this crate supplies only the
# persona-specific nouns + lean `list` fields (with `role`) via a CliSpec.
# Shared CLI scaffold (#1762): `CmdDoc` for the per-command help catalog.
# `model` validates a non-tier name against what the LOCAL RUNTIME has installed — the one rule lives
# in `llm::cli::verify_model`, beside the blocking probe it needs, rather than being restated here.
# `set` reads its own payload (stdin/`--file`) so it can carry a builtin's `proseSeal`/`replacedProse`
# forward before writing (#172 follow-up) — already a transitive dep via bsc-json-store, so this adds
# no new build cost.
# The ONE home-dir resolver (#1646) — `rename` resolves the persona store the same way the shared
# scaffold does (`--dir` > env > `~/.base-studio-code/personas`) — AND the canonical model-tier
# registry `model` validates against, so a tier this CLI accepts is one the harness can launch.
# `rename` patches ONE field of the stored record without re-serializing a typed model.
# The wire contract for `bsc persona use` (#change-a-panes-persona-from-the-cli) crosses the appchan,
# so its request/result shapes are derived rather than hand-rolled.
# The ONE bsc->app request channel — `use` changes frontend state, so it rides the same transport as
# `bsc shot` / `bsc navigate` / `bsc fleet` rather than a second one.
